items.content: U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent said the dollar briefly surged back to levels seen two months ago.
美国财长贝森特：美元一度大幅上涨，回到两个月前的水平。
U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent said the dollar has remained very stable and that the Treasury will continue to pursue a
美国财长贝森特：美元一直非常稳定，继续奉行强势美元政策。
During US Treasury Secretary Bessent's remarks, spot gold and spot silver rose briefly; spot gold turned positive on the
美国财长贝森特讲话期间，现货黄金、现货白银短线上涨，现货黄金日内转涨0.2%，报4532.28美元/盎司，现货白银上涨2.8%，报68.85美元/盎司。
U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent said the budget director Watt knows where spending can be cut.
美国财长贝森特：预算主管沃特知道我们可以从哪里削减开支。
SHFE silver 2610 contract strengthened intraday, up as much as 4.03% to CNY16,762/kg; turnover topped CNY76bn and open i
沪银2610盘中明显走强，涨幅扩大至4.03%，价格上探16762元/千克，成交额已超760亿元；日内增仓1.99万手，持仓变化明显。
US Treasury Secretary Bessent said employment data has been highly volatile.
美国财长贝森特：就业数据“相当嘈杂”。
U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent said tighter immigration controls would reduce the number of jobs needed.
美国财长贝森特：在加强移民管控后，不需要那么多就业岗位。
US Treasury Secretary Bessent said the US does control the Strait of Hormuz.
美国财长贝森特：我们确实控制着霍尔木兹海峡。
U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent vowed the U.S. will impose the harshest sanctions in history and will "overthrow this re
美国财长贝森特：将实施史上最严厉的制裁。我们将“推翻这个政权”。
U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent said the actions will limit Iran's ability to act through proxies.
美国财长贝森特：这些行动将限制伊朗通过代理采取行动的能力。
U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent said if countries continue to do business with Iran, the U.S. will take action against t
美国财长贝森特：（关于伊朗）如果各国坚持与伊朗开展业务，美国将对其采取行动。
U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent said core inflation has declined in both goods and services.
美国财长贝森特：核心通胀，无论是商品还是服务均有所下降。
U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent said Washington will implement coordinated economic isolation measures.
美国财长贝森特：将实施协调一致的经济孤立措施。
U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent said on Iran that maximum economic pressure suggests military action may not be resumed,
美国财长贝森特：（关于伊朗）最大经济压力意味着可能不会重新启动军事行动。石油市场误解了经济压力的含义。

美国财长贝森特：（关于伊朗经济制裁）将于下周一举行新闻发布会，讨论相关行动。
